newsitem.title: CHINA: China to unify treasury bond system in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China to unify treasury bond system in 1997.

text.p: China will this year unify its system for treasury bond registration, custody, settlement and clearance, the official Xinhua news agency on Friday quoted a top Ministry of Finance official as saying.
Beijing would seek to develop the over-the-counter state bond market and accelerate the issue of paperless bonds, said Gao Jian, director of the ministry's State Debt Management Department.

"At present, treasury bond clearance, settlement, and custody are carried out in the respective exchanges, while the transfer of custody of government bonds is simply impossible, which is detrimental to the development of the bond market," Gao said.

To help further improve the central bank's ability to regulate the money supply and to implement its monetary policy, the finance ministry would continue to issue short-term treasury bonds on a relatively fixed timetable, Gao said.
Medium-term bonds should be floated when old bonds were redeemed, in order to stabilise the market, Xinhua quoted him as saying but gave no further details.
China's has said it will issue treasury bonds worth 248.596 billion yuan in 1997.
